From the brand

PRO CLUB

It all started with a classic white t-shirt. Pro Club is now an iconic American clothing brand steeped in history and culture.

  2. Comfort & Style Since 86'

    Pro Club is the definitive apparel brand based in Los Angeles, California. For 35 years, the brand has personified the soul and enduring look of West Coast aesthetics.

    Far from its humble beginnings, Pro Club now offers a wide range of apparel, from every day essentials and street fashion to active wear and accessories, all with a focus on ready to wear comfort & style.

  3. Everyday Essentials

    Getting dressed doesn't need to be complicated. Pro Club apparel is designed with everyday wear in mind.

  4. Premium Quality

    Pro Club is known for its quality. Every piece is manufactured to the highest standard. Simply put, our clothing is built to last.

  5. Impecable Style

    Look as good on the outside as you feel on the inside. Pro Club stays on top of trends and even, dare we say.. set a few of our own.

  6. Always Comfortable

    There's no compromising on comfort. Pro Club apparel is made with premium fabrics and materials tailored to perfection.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find the t-shirt to be of unmatched quality with a nice tight crew neck that doesn't sag, and appreciate its thick cotton fabric and heavyweight construction, considering it good value for money. The fabric quality receives mixed feedback, with some praising the thick cotton blend while others find it coarse. Customers disagree on the sizing, with some noting the sleeves are the perfect length while others find them abnormally small. Additionally, customers report issues with shrinkage, noting that the shirts shrink significantly after about four washes.

    I have only worn these a few times, but so far so good. Like others, I got tired of the wimpy collar, wimpy fabric, too-short-arms tshirts that we have all had. So I got 3 of these to try them out. I'm still trying them out, but I ordered another 3 in a color.

    These are a beefy fabric (like maybe Carhartt-beefy fabric? Close, anyway.) They may be a little too thick to wear under a long sleeve shirt or flannel shirt like some of us do in the winter. I'm not sure yet. And the collars are tight. Others have reported on this, and it's true. They are a bit scratchy (the whole fabric is) but then they haven't been washed much yet maybe that will go away. I guess I'd rather have the collar a little too tight than saggy. Like the rest of you I suspect, I've had enough saggy collars to last a lifetime.

    So I rate these a 4 but it could go up to a 5 with a few washings and some more wearing. They are stout tshirts!
